{{recipe}}

For all of you who would like to make your own applesauce, but without having to do much work, this recipe is for you.

== Ingredients ==
* 5 [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], peeled, cored, and [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] apple [[Cookbook:Jelly|jelly]]
* ¼ cup Grade B Amber [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]] (Grade A Dark Amber would be okay too)
* ¼ cup freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Orange juice|orange juice]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] stick

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients in a microwave-safe container. 
#Cover container, leaving 1 corner open, and microwave on high 7–8 minutes or until apples are easy to mash.
#Remove cinnamon stick and discard.
#For a chunky sauce, mash the apples with a potato [[Cookbook:Masher|masher]]. For a slightly smoother sauce, use a hand [[Cookbook:Mixer|mixer]]. For a smooth [[Cookbook:Puréeing|pureé]], use an immersion [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]].
